meta.description: 3D Light & Shadow Smart Curtain: vertical wave-pattern slats that rotate 170°, daylight-sensing automation, 5° steps on MixPad, a 30 dB motor, 4 scene modes and Zigbee 3.0.
meta.spec.description: 3D Light & Shadow Smart Curtain specifications: model W10MZ, Zigbee, 100–240 V AC, 54 W rated power, 1.2 N·m torque, 50 kg load capacity, IP20.
tiles.rotate:
Rotating slats
for shade or light
sec1.title_3d: Vertical wave curtain, elegant 3D light and shadow
sec1.desc: A water-ripple wave design in Pattaya polymer fabric, formed in one piece so it drapes well and finely cut for straight lines: elegant 3D light and shadow for your home.
sec1.title_3d2: Slats that rotate 170°, for shade or light
sec1.desc2: The slats rotate through 170° to let in just the light you need, so daylight indoors is yours to set.
sec3.title_3d: Senses daylight and fine-tunes it for you
sec3.desc: Paired with the MixSense S360 presence sensor, it measures the light in the room and sets how far the curtain opens and how its slats tilt, for effortless smart shading.
sec4.title_3d: Set it by the percent, tilt the slats at will
sec4.desc: Forget the old button remote: an intuitive slider on MixPad sets the slat angle in 5° steps, so you decide exactly how bright the room is.
sec5.desc: Helical gears keep the noise down to just 30 dB, so you enjoy smart living in peace and quiet.
sec6.title_3d: 4 scene modes, smart living your way
sec6.desc: Set up 4 scene modes that open the curtain and angle its slats by the amounts you choose, automatically. Smart living, defined by you.
sec6.bg_title: Separate slats: easy to take down, wash any time
sec6.bg_desc: The curtain is made of independent slats, so each one can be taken down and washed on its own.
sec7.subtitle: Smooth, seamless joint pieces
sec7.title:
Seamless joints
that let no light through
sec7.desc: Smooth joint pieces close every gap where the track sections meet, so no light leaks through at the joints.
sec7.desc2: With Zigbee 3.0 and a redesigned structure that cuts electronic interference, the signal is far stronger and more sensitive and passes easily through walls: it responds in milliseconds and connects at up to 85 m*.
sec7.readme: [1] ORVIBO lab test data (up to 85 m in open space, up to 30 m in a home). Interference differs from place to place, so real-world results may vary. [2] ORVIBO lab test data; the longer reception range is compared with most smart curtains that use Bluetooth or Wi-Fi.
